title: Musa and the Google Quantum AI challenge
caption: Google Quantum AI is running a Kaggle challenge with $50,000 for 1st place ⚛️ Python & ML skills help, solo or team. Join by 13 Jan, final 20 Jan 2027. Comment LINK 👇 #kaggle #quantumcomputing #ai #machinelearning

scenes.backdrop: futuristic tech lab with glowing quantum computer, blue lights and screens

beats.text: Quddus, what is quantum computing? Every time I read about it, my brain goes into two states. Confused and very confused.
beats.say: Kuddus, what is quantum computing? Every time I read about it, my brain goes into two states. Confused and very confused.

beats.text: Ha! You don't need to be a physicist to try this. Google Quantum AI has a Kaggle challenge.
beats.say: Ha! You don't need to be a physicist to try this. Google Quantum A.I. has a Kaggle challenge.
Fifty thousand dollars? My laptop just started sweating.
You use free Kaggle notebooks. Python and machine learning skills help.

scenes.backdrop: modern café with laptops, plants and big windows

beats.text: Create a free Kaggle account, find the Google Quantum AI challenge, accept the rules by January thirteenth, and submit by January twentieth.
beats.say: Create a free Kaggle account, find the Google Quantum A.I. challenge, accept the rules by January thirteenth, and submit by January twentieth.

beats.text: You still learn, and a good public notebook looks great on your CV.
beats.say: You still learn, and a good public notebook looks great on your C.V..
Musa, quantum explorer. Both states: excited!

scenes.backdrop: starry night sky over a calm city with teal and gold lights, cinematic
